en.title: South Korea's president: We will not deploy our military to fight in the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung stated that Seoul will not send its military to intervene militarily in a potential conflict between the United States and Iran.

en.title: Companies, tech specialists, and global hackathon winners at Riyadh UNESCO forum
en.summary: Over 20 companies received artificial intelligence ethics badges from Saudi Arabia's Data and AI Authority during the fourth UNESCO Global Forum on AI Ethics, recognizing their commitment to ethical principles in developing AI products and services.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia welcomes proposed F-35 fighter jets deal as regional tensions rise

en.title: Saudi Arabia welcomes proposed F-35 fighter jets deal as regional tensions rise
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's embassy in Washington expressed support for a proposed US sale of F-35 fighter jets to the Kingdom, characterizing it as reinforcement of the long-standing strategic partnership and defense cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: Man who assaulted US lawmaker Ilhan Omar sentenced to 14 months in prison

en.title: Man who assaulted US lawmaker Ilhan Omar sentenced to 14 months in prison
en.summary: A Minnesota man who attacked Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar by squirting vinegar on her was sentenced to 14 months in prison after pleading guilty to assaulting a federal official based on disagreement with her political views.

stories.title: Ocean container shipping rates could test record highs as Iran war fuel spike drives rise, analysts say

en.title: Ocean container shipping rates could test record highs as Iran war fuel spike drives rise, analysts say
en.summary: Shipping rates from China to the US East Coast have surged to post-COVID levels and may reach record highs due to increased fuel costs from the Iran conflict. Spot rates hit $10,948 per container, more than quadrupling since late February.

en.title: North Korean leader's sister attacks US military drills and threatens more aggressive response
en.summary: Kim Jong Un's sister accused the United States of escalating regional tensions through repeated military exercises and warned of a more aggressive counterresponse.

stories.title: OpenAI, Microsoft executives’ quotes on AI training threaten copyright defense, news outlets argue

en.title: OpenAI, Microsoft executives' quotes on AI training threaten copyright defense, news outlets argue
en.summary: Court filings reveal private statements by OpenAI and Microsoft executives describing their AI as journalism substitutes, which news outlets claim undermines the companies' fair-use arguments in a copyright lawsuit.

en.title: Washington: Withdrawal from the war causes energy crisis
en.summary: US Vice President JD Vance defended continued American military involvement in the region, arguing that withdrawal and leaving regional nations to face challenges alone would create problems.

en.title: UN warns of war's impact on Yemen aid
en.summary: The United Nations has expressed concern that ongoing conflict in Yemen is hampering the delivery of humanitarian assistance to the country, where over 100,000 people have been displaced since early September.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s US Treasury holdings rise by $10.7 billion in July

en.title: Saudi Arabia's US Treasury holdings rise by $10.7 billion in July
en.summary: Saudi Arabia increased its US Treasury investments by 10.7 billion dollars in July 2026 compared to the same month the previous year, an 8 percent annual increase, though monthly holdings declined slightly to 142.4 billion dollars.

stories.title: Civil Defense: One Killed, Two Injured by Intercepted Houthi Drone Debris in Taif

en.title: Civil Defense: One Killed, Two Injured by Intercepted Houthi Drone Debris in Taif
en.summary: One person was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Taif.

stories.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif

en.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif
en.summary: A Yemeni resident was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Saudi Arabia's Taif, also causing material damage to buildings and vehicles.

stories.title: ‎Red Sea Global, Sulaiman Al Habib open Red Sea Hospital

en.title: Red Sea Global, Sulaiman Al Habib open Red Sea Hospital
en.summary: Red Sea Global and Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Services Group opened Red Sea Hospital at The Red Sea destination on September 17. The hospital will provide healthcare services to employees, residents, guests, and local communities under a strategic partnership.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia issues 268 industrial licenses in May worth SAR 2.2B

en.title: Saudi Arabia issues 268 industrial licenses in May worth SAR 2.2B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources granted 268 industrial licenses in May valued at SAR 2.23 billion. These projects are projected to create over 2,484 jobs, while 149 factories began production with SAR 1.43 billion in investments.

stories.title: ‎KEC to launch Knowledge Gardens fund within 6 months: CIO

en.title: KEC to launch Knowledge Gardens fund within 6 months: CIO
en.summary: Knowledge Economic City's Chief Investment Officer stated that procedures to establish an investment fund for the Knowledge Gardens project should be completed within six months. The company is finalizing agreements and project structure with fund managers.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Printing shareholders to vote on 89.4% capital cut on Oct. 26

en.title: Saudi Printing shareholders to vote on 89.4% capital cut on Oct. 26
en.summary: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co. will hold a shareholder vote to reduce its capital from SAR 652.07 million to SAR 68.97 million, eliminating SAR 583.10 million in accumulated losses through the restructuring.

stories.title: ‎Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe

en.title: Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe
en.summary: Lucid Group and Bolt announced a partnership to develop and deploy autonomous vehicles across Europe, with Bolt planning to operate at least 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles by 2035.
